issue_context.title: Custom terrain palette loader causes linter error: Duplicate palette definition for palette name terrain
issue_context.body:
<!-- This is a guideline that shall help you to include information we need to understand and fix the issue you experienced. Please follow the instructions and replace any placeholders that are written in capital letters. Instructions like this comment will not be visible in your report. -->

<!-- Important: Help us to avoid duplicates and use the search function to find existing reports for your issue. Please do not submit duplicate reports! Try to help others to find your report by using a precise title. -->

## Issue Summary
<!-- Please provide a a clear and concise description of what the issue is below. -->

I'm using a custom palette loader for OpenDR terrain palettes and this block in `CheckPalettes` erroneously triggers a linter error indicating duplicate palette definitions:

```c#
// PaletteFromFile might only be active for a single tileset
// So ignore any duplicate palette names as long as they are on different tilesets
if (traitInfo is PaletteFromFileInfo paletteFromFileInfo && paletteFromFileInfo.Tileset != null)
{
	var tilesetPalette = (paletteFromFileInfo.Tileset, value);
	if (tilesetPalettes.Contains(tilesetPalette))
		emitError($"Duplicate palette definition for palette name {value}");
	else
	{
		tilesetPalettes.Add(tilesetPalette);

		// Only add the basic palette name once
		if (!palettes.Contains(value))
			palettes.Add(value);
	}
}
else
{
	if (palettes.Contains(value))
		emitError($"Duplicate palette definition for palette name {value}");

	palettes.Add(value);
}
```

## Reproduction
<!-- Please provide information about how the issue can be reproduced below. -->

If terrain palette info is provided using a class besides `PaletteFromFileInfo` for multiple tilesets, the issue will manifest.

OpenDR is using tileset defs like:

```miniyaml
PaletteFromDrFile@terrain-barren:
    Name: terrain
    Filename: BARREN/BARREN.PAL
    Tileset: BARREN
    ShadowIndex: 47
    StandardPaletteMultiplier: 4
    TerrainPaletteMultiplier: 6
    Gamma: 0
PaletteFromDrFile@terrain-aust:
    Name: terrain
    Filename: aust.pal
    Tileset: AUST
    ShadowIndex: 47
    StandardPaletteMultiplier: 4
    TerrainPaletteMultiplier: 5
    Gamma: 0
```

A dev suggested that a new interface is required for tileset-specific palettes and this check altered to use that instead of `PaletteFromFileInfo`.

review_comments: or something like that. I'm not a fan of the current name

We already have `TilesetSpecificSpriteSequence`, which is where I got the idea. "Palette with tileset info" is good, but since this is an info type it would be `IPaletteWithTilesetInfoInfo`, otherwise it's just "palette with tileset". 😅
